extDescription.message: Download a video's transcript and summarize it with the AI of your choice (Gemini, Mistral, Infomaniak, Ollama…). Works with YouTube.

errNotVideoPage.message: Open a YouTube video page first (youtube.com/watch?v=...).

errNoVoice.message: No voice is installed for this language ($LANGUAGE$). You can add one in your system's text-to-speech settings.

errSpeechUnsupported.message: Read aloud isn't available in this browser.

errNoVideo.message: No video detected. Open a YouTube page like youtube.com/watch?v=...

errPanelOpen.message: Couldn't open the transcript panel automatically. Open it manually ("..." under the video → "Show transcript") and try again.

errPanelEmpty.message: The transcript panel is open but its content couldn't be read (YouTube may have changed its page structure).

errProductId.message: Replace {product_id} in the URL with your AI Services product ID.

errUrlProtocol.message: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

errOllamaNetwork.message: Can't reach the local server. Check that Ollama is running and allows the extension (OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*").

errNetwork.message: Can't reach the AI provider (network issue or permission denied).

optSubtitle.message: Choose the service that will generate summaries. Downloading the transcript (.txt) works without any setup.

optModelHint.message: Keep the suggested value if you're not sure.

optAutoPlay.message: Read the summary aloud as soon as it's ready

optVoiceHint.message: Used for summaries in its language; other languages use the system's default voice. You can install more voices in your system's text-to-speech settings.

optVoiceWindowsHint.message: Windows 11 natural voices (Denise, Aria…) don't appear directly in Firefox: see how to add them.

speechSample.message: Hello! This is how Vidigest will read your summaries.

optNotice.message:
Important: Vidigest has no server. When you click “Summarize”, the video transcript is sent directly to the provider selected above, using your own key. You are responsible for complying with its terms of use and for its billing. For example, the Gemini API terms restrict use for users in the European Economic Area, Switzerland and the United Kingdom to paid services.
Your key is stored only in your browser (not synced, not encrypted).

helpGemini.message: Create a key at aistudio.google.com. For use from Europe, Google's terms require a project with billing enabled.

helpMistral.message: Create a key at console.mistral.ai. French provider, pay-as-you-go (a free trial is available).

helpInfomaniak.message: Enable AI Services in the Infomaniak Manager, create an API token, then replace {product_id} in the URL with your product ID. Hosted in Switzerland.

helpOllama.message: Install Ollama, download a model (ollama pull llama3.2) and start it while allowing the extension: OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*" ollama serve. Nothing leaves your computer and no key is needed.

helpCustom.message: Any service compatible with the OpenAI API (OpenAI, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter…). Enter the full URL ending with /chat/completions. Firefox will ask for permission to access that site.

toastPermissionDenied.message: ✗ Permission denied: the extension can't contact this service.
